caption:
Apple is back with another MacBook Pro refresh, keeping the same classic design while packing in the new M6 chip and faster Wi-Fi 7. But if you want to upgrade that storage, get ready to pay extra. Are you upgrading your laptop every year, or making it last until it gives up? 💻✨

@apple

Source: The Verge, 9to5Mac

#Apple #MacBookPro #TechNews #Gadgets #ConsumerTech

post.news: Apple just dropped a new 14-inch MacBook Pro powered by the M6 chip, starting at $1,999 with 16GB of memory.
post.take: Same exact look as last year, but upgrading your storage now costs enough to fund a small vacation.
post.insight: Apple continues to iterate safely on hardware while squeezing maximum margins out of component shortages and high-tier storage upgrades.
